crossRefs.note: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
Let still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy…
For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

translations.web: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
translations.bsb: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.
translations.kjv: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
translations.asv: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
